adjudication: The record not corresponding to deposito L4 explicitly excludes the requested subject from that record, not the asset state or occurrence of its event
authority: Explicit root authorization after independent DEV D16 adjudication, before the first candidate-reserve gate
candidate_sha_freeze_scope: next candidate SHA using v2.1, before the first candidate-reserve gate
compact_schema: missing false flags are allowed only with policy v1 limits, evaluated_chars exact, emitted_extent exact, and explicit final scopes; explicit malformed values fail
correction: A literal same-ID nominal subject explicitly shared by query and exact witness may follow a/al; source membership, exact spans and non-hypothetical single-negation guards remain mandatory
counterevidence_requirements: applicable literal reason and exact offsets/text within the final emitted excerpt; omitted or metadata-only text cannot justify exclusion
discrepancy: The original v1 harness counted every negative selected context item, which additionally prohibited related material even when it was not presented as sufficient evidence.
guarded_scope: Spanish literal bare identifier or one-to-three-word explicitly shared nominal phrase; no crossing prepositions/clauses, no skipping another first identifier, no hypothetical/denied/multiply-negated assertions
legacy_counter_retained: legacy_negative_context_selections; original negative_unsupported_evidence remains in the unchanged canonical baseline
positive_sufficiency: valid evidence_candidate, frozen grade-3 logical document, entire factual body present in the final excerpt; otherwise UNKNOWN, never automatic failure-as-fact or pass
regrading_policy: write separate v2.1 reports alongside unchanged v2 reports; 1718 still fails positive sufficiency at 14/16
related_material_requirements: nonempty missing necessary requirements reproduced from final text
pinned bytes and captured resource/revision/evidence references
concrete source locator and exact final emitted extent
explicit excerpt-only scope and complete bounded checks
retrieval_metrics_unchanged: Success@5 over unique pinned logical resources
nDCG@10 with frozen graded relevance, not below the immutable baseline
sentence_context_guard: Non-affirmation checks inspect only the same sentence of the final excerpt containing the exact witness; internal spans cannot hide a denial/condition, soft-wrap newlines are preserved, another sentence is not borrowed
validation_scope: independent dev metric unit tests and two synthetic core-v2 compatibility probes only; not acceptance of a model or candidate
